name: cr605_3a_no_auto_mana_manual_payment
why: CR 605.3a / 601.2g-h: with --no-auto-mana a land's mana ability is offered at priority (mana:r floats {R} there, which pays the first Lightning Bolt) and a cost the pool doesn't cover goes through the payment loop (tap:Mountain pays the second, cast in response); both resolve and the game goes on (plan step 4a, auto-mana)
expect_order: Player A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears
Player A casts Lightning Bolt targeting Player B
Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to Player B
